messages:
Alice Nguyen: RC build ready from commit abc1234 — artifact rc-2026-03-21-1. tagging for promo window 09:00-11:00 UTC. pls ack pin and canary plan :raised_hands:
Ben Park: ack. pin requested. canaries -> 5% traffic for 15m, then 25% for 30m if green.
Carla Ruiz: added release notes blurb in /docs/release-notes/rc-2026-03-21.md. small DB migration (add col nullable) included. no schema lock.
sheriff-jen: i'll be on sheriff for the window. will watch latencies + errors. set me as contact in the ticket.
Alice Nguyen: deploy-bot, please stage canary to us-east-1 and run smoke tests. tag the promo with metadata: {"rc":"rc-2026-03-21-1","owner":"alice"}
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: stage=canary region=us-east-1 artifact=rc-2026-03-21-1

deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded (instance pool gp2), smoke tests: PASS. logs: https://logs.internal/r/rc-2026-03-21-1
Ben Park: observed baseline tail latency +5ms, token CPU stable. metrics look fine so far.
Carla Ruiz: quick note — embedding service config bumped to v2 to support quantized model. watch mem on embeders.
sheriff-jen: alert threshold set: 3% error rate or 2x baseline latency for 5m -> rollback signal.
Alice Nguyen: thumbs up. schedule promo at 09:30 UTC if no alerts by 09:15.
Ben Park: also pin artifact in registry: `registry.pin("inference-service", "rc-2026-03-21-1")`
Carla Ruiz: done. registry shows pin at 1763654400.
deploy-bot: Promo checklist: [artifact pinned] [canary passed] [sheriff assigned] [release notes linked] — ready for promotion.
Alice Nguyen: executing promo now. deploy-bot, promote to prod-shard-1/2 with stagger 10%.
deploy-bot: Promotion started: stage=staggered shards=[prod-shard-1,prod-shard-2] initial=10%

deploy-bot: Promo progress: 10% -> 30% -> 60% (2m intervals). smoke checks continuing.
Ben Park: watching logs, minor 500 spikes on region europe-west-1 at 30% ramp. they trended back down in ~90s. not breaching alert.
sheriff-jen: holding until 60% completes. no manual rollback yet.
Carla Ruiz: pushing config tweak to retry logic for the embedder (backoff + jitter). will index canary patch if needed.

deploy-bot: Promotion reached 100% on prod-shard-1, 80% on prod-shard-2. finalizing.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. artifact rc-2026-03-21-1 is now live.
Alice Nguyen: great — releasing release notes and marking RC as promoted in the release docket.
Ben Park: post-promote sanity: QPS +3%, cost stable, 99th latency unchanged. will keep an eye for next 2 hours.
sheriff-jen: oncall will watch overnight. if errors > 3% for 5m, trigger rollback.
Carla Ruiz: adding rollback playbook snippet here for quick exec:
```
# rollback steps
1) `deploy-bot rollback --artifact previous-stable --target all`
2) unpin rc-2026-03-21-1 in registry
3) revert embedder config if patch applied
4) notify customers via status page
```
Alice Nguyen: thanks team. closing the RC thread — filing follow-up for perf tweak tickets. :white_check_mark:
